title: The Unwanted Power
summary: Ha-Jun struggles desperately to control his superhuman physical strength and heightened senses in daily life. At school, Min-Jae confronts him with a suspicious note just as a mandatory Bloodline Quest appears—commanding him to enter the subterranean void beneath the campus.

panels.action: Early morning sunlight cuts through plastic window blinds, illuminating dust motes dancing over Ha-Jun's modest bed.
panels.prose_en: Early morning sunlight cuts through plastic window blinds, illuminating dust motes dancing over Ha-Jun's modest bed.
panels.prose_hi: Subah-subah suraj ki roshni plastic ki khidki ke pardon ko kaatati hai, jisse ha-jun ke mamuli bistar par dhul ke kan nachte hue dikhai dete han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches his hand to switch off the plastic alarm clock; his thumb lightly presses down, shattering the plastic casing into pieces.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches his hand to switch off the plastic alarm clock; his thumb lightly presses down, shattering the plastic casing into pieces.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun plastic alarm ghadi ko band karne ke liye apna haath badhata hai; uska angutha halke se dabata hai, jisse plastic ka aavaran tukdon mein bikhar jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun sits up in bed staring in disbelief at the shattered plastic gears in his palm: 'M-Maine toh bas halke se chhua tha!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine toh bas halka sa dabaya tha...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits up in bed staring in disbelief at the shattered plastic gears in his palm: 'M-Maine toh bas halke se chhua tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bistar par baith jata hai aur avishvas se apni hatheli mein toote hue plastic gears ko dekhta hai: 'm-maine to bus halke se chhua tha!'

panels.action: In the bathroom sink, Ha-Jun tries to turn the brass faucet; the solid metal twists like clay under his fingers, spraying water across the mirror.
panels.prose_en: In the bathroom sink, Ha-Jun tries to turn the brass faucet; the solid metal twists like clay under his fingers, spraying water across the mirror.
panels.prose_hi: Bathroom ke sink men, ha-jun pital ke nal ko chalu karne ki koshish karta hai; thos dhatu uski ungaliyon ke neeche mitti ki tarah mud jaati hai, aur darpan par pani chhidakti hai.

panels.action: Kuro perches on the shower rod, snickering: 'Tumhari muscle density barah guna badh gayi hai. Insaani dimaag abhi calibrate nahi hua.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Insaani dimaag ko Sovereign ki taqat samajhne mein waqt lagta hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro perches on the shower rod, snickering: 'Tumhari muscle density barah guna badh gayi hai. Insaani dimaag abhi calibrate nahi hua.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro shower rod par baith kar hanste hue kehta hai: 'tumhari manspeshiyon ka ghanatv barah guna badh gai hai. insaani dimag abhi calibrate nahin hua.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks into the wet mirror: His face is sharper, bruises completely vanished, but his irises flicker violet when he gets agitated.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar school mein kisi ko chhooya... toh haddi toot jayegi!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks into the wet mirror: His face is sharper, bruises completely vanished, but his irises flicker violet when he gets agitated.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun gile darpan mein dekhta hai: uska chehra tej ho gaya hai, chot ke nishan puri tarah se gayab ho gaye han, lekin jab wah uttejit hota hai to uski aankhen baingani rang ki chamakti han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches the edges of the porcelain sink, taking deep measured breaths: 'Mujhe isse control karna hoga.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Control... mujhe is taqat ko control karna hoga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clutches the edges of the porcelain sink, taking deep measured breaths: 'Mujhe isse control karna hoga.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun chini mitti ke sink ke kinaron ko pakadta hai aur gahri gahri saansein leta hai: 'mujhe ise control karna hoga.'

panels.action: Kuro: 'Mana ko apne core mein khencho. Bahar bahaav ko band karo jab tak jung ka waqt na ho.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Mana ko andar kheench kar rakh, ladke.

panels.prose_en: Kuro: 'Mana ko apne core mein khencho. Bahar bahaav ko band karo jab tak jung ka waqt na ho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro: 'mana ko apne core mein khencho. bahar bahav ko band karo jab tak jung ka waqt na ho.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun walks gingerly through a packed morning commuter subway platform, stepping with extreme care as if walking on thin glass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks gingerly through a packed morning commuter subway platform, stepping with extreme care as if walking on thin glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun khachakhach bhare subah ke yatriyon ke liye metro platform par savdhani se chalta hai, atyadhik savdhani se kadam badhata hai jaise ki wah patle sheeshe par chal raha ho.

panels.action: A hurried salaryman bumps hard into Ha-Jun's shoulder—and bounces straight backward as if hitting a reinforced titanium pillar.
panels.prose_en: A hurried salaryman bumps hard into Ha-Jun's shoulder—and bounces straight backward as if hitting a reinforced titanium pillar.
panels.prose_hi: Ek hadbadi mein vetanbhogi karmchari ha-jun ke kandhe se jor se takrata hai aur sidhe peeche ki or uchhalta hai mano kisi prabalit titanium khambhe se takra raha ho.

panels.action: The man rubs his shoulder in agony: 'Arey yaar! Yeh ladka lohe ka bana hai kya?!'

dialogue.text: Lohe ka bana hai kya yeh ladka?!

panels.prose_en: The man rubs his shoulder in agony: 'Arey yaar! Yeh ladka lohe ka bana hai kya?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vah aadmi peeda se apna kandha ragadata hai: 'are yar! yeh ladka lohe ka bana hai kya?!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun bows quickly in apology: 'M-Maaf kijiye!' (Thought: 'Mera wazan zameen se jud gaya hai.')

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera sharir itna solid ho gaya hai...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bows quickly in apology: 'M-Maaf kijiye!' (Thought: 'Mera wazan zameen se jud gaya hai.').
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun maafi maangte hue teji se jhukta hai: 'm-maf kijiye!' (socha: 'mera vazan zameen se jud gaya hai.').

panels.action: Inside the train, concentric sound rings vibrate around Ha-Jun: He can hear fifty distinct heartbeats, whispering phones, and shoe squeaks.
panels.prose_en: Inside the train, concentric sound rings vibrate around Ha-Jun: He can hear fifty distinct heartbeats, whispering phones, and shoe squeaks.
panels.prose_hi: Tren ke ander, ha-jun ke charon or sankendrit dhwani ke chhalle kampan karte han: wah pachas alg-alg dil ki dhadkan, fusfusate hue phone aur jute ki cheekh sun sakta hai.

panels.action: System UI flashes: [PASSIVE UNLOCKED: DEMONIC AUDITORY ENHANCEMENT] | [FILTER CALIBRATING: 65%].
panels.prose_en: System UI flashes: [PASSIVE UNLOCKED: DEMONIC AUDITORY ENHANCEMENT] | [FILTER CALIBRATING: 65%].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm ui flash: [nishkriya unlock: rakshasi shravan vridhi] | [filter anshankan: 65%].

panels.action: Ha-Jun breathes through his nose, focusing his core to suppress the sound waves until normal quiet returns.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun breathes through his nose, focusing his core to suppress the sound waves until normal quiet returns.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni naak se saans leta hai, samanya shanti lautne tak dhwani tarangon ko dabane ke liye apne core par dhyan kendrit karta hai.

panels.action: The train doors slide open at Saint Mirren University station; student crowds surge onto the platform.
panels.prose_en: The train doors slide open at Saint Mirren University station; student crowds surge onto the platform.
panels.prose_hi: Sent miren university station par train ke darwaze khulte han; chhatron ki bheed manch par umad padi.

panels.action: In Classroom 3-B, sunlight fills the room as students chat; Ha-Jun sits quietly at his corner window desk.

dialogue.text: Classroom 3-B. Wahi jagah jahan sab badal chuka tha.

panels.prose_en: In Classroom 3-B, sunlight fills the room as students chat; Ha-Jun sits quietly at his corner window desk.
panels.prose_hi: Kaksha 3-bi men, jab chhatra baatcheet karte hain to suraj ki roshni kamre mein bhar jaati hai; ha-jun apni kone wali khidki wali mej par chupchap baitha hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun holds a wooden pencil with feather-light touch, sweating slightly as he writes notes without snapping the lead.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun holds a wooden pencil with feather-light touch, sweating slightly as he writes notes without snapping the lead.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke haath mein pankhon jaisa halka sparsh wala ek lakdi ka pencil hai, bina lead tode note likhte samay use thoda pasina aa raha hai.

panels.action: Across the aisle two desks down, Min-Jae adjusts his glasses, his sharp gaze locked onto Ha-Jun's calm posture.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Kal chhat par kuch bohot ajeeb hua tha...

panels.prose_en: Across the aisle two desks down, Min-Jae adjusts his glasses, his sharp gaze locked onto Ha-Jun's calm posture.
panels.prose_hi: Galiyare ke paar do desk niche, min-je ne apna chashma samayojit kiya, uski tez nazar ha-jun ki shant mudra par tiki hui thi.

panels.action: The literature teacher at the chalkboard points: 'Kang Ha-Jun, page 42 ka paragraph 3 read karo.'
panels.prose_en: The literature teacher at the chalkboard points: 'Kang Ha-Jun, page 42 ka paragraph 3 read karo.'.
panels.prose_hi: Chockbord par sahitya shikshak ingit karta hai: 'cong ha-jun, page 42 ka paragraph 3 padho karo.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands up and begins reading: His voice carries an accidental, deep baritone resonance that vibrates the window panes.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands up and begins reading: His voice carries an accidental, deep baritone resonance that vibrates the window panes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun khada hota hai aur padhna shuru karta hai: uski awaz mein ek aakasmik, gahri barriton pratidhvani hoti hai jo khidki ke sheeshe ko kampan karti hai.

panels.action: All chatter instantly dies; every single student and the teacher freeze, goosebumps prickling on their arms.

dialogue.text: Uske gale se nikli aawaz ne sabko khamosh kar diya.

panels.prose_en: All chatter instantly dies; every single student and the teacher freeze, goosebumps prickling on their arms.
panels.prose_hi: Sari bakbak turant samapt ho jaati hai; har ek chhatra aur shikshak thithak gaye, unki banhon par rongte khade ho gaye.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clears his throat, brings his voice back to normal student pitch, and quickly sits down with a reddening neck.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Gadbad ho gayi... meri aawaz mein bhi mana aa raha hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clears his throat, brings his voice back to normal student pitch, and quickly sits down with a reddening neck.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna gala saaf karta hai, apni awaaz ko samanya chhatra swar mein wapas lata hai, aur lal gardan ke saath jaldi se baith jata hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae discreetly slides a tightly folded piece of notebook paper across the wooden desk onto Ha-Jun's notebook.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae discreetly slides a tightly folded piece of notebook paper across the wooden desk onto Ha-Jun's notebook.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne savdhani se notebook paper ke ek kaskar mude hue tukde ko lakdi ke desk par ha-jun ki notebook par sarka diya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun unfolds the paper under his desk: 'Class ke baad purane auditorium ke peeche milo. Mujhe pata hai kal tumne kya kiya.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: 'Mujhe pata hai kal tumne kya kiya.'

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun unfolds the paper under his desk: 'Class ke baad purane auditorium ke peeche milo. Mujhe pata hai kal tumne kya kiya.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne desk ke neeche kagaj kholta hai: 'clas ke baad purane auditorium ke peeche milo. mujhe pata hai kal tumne kya kiya.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun's heart hammers in his chest; his fingers crumple the note tightly in his palm.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae ne kal mujhe dekh liya tha...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's heart hammers in his chest; his fingers crumple the note tightly in his palm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka dil uske seene mein dhadak raha hai; uski ungaliyan note ko uski hatheli mein kas kar masal deti han.

panels.action: Before he can even breathe, a deafening holographic chime rings directly in Ha-Jun's skull: *DINGGGGGG!!*
panels.prose_en: Before he can even breathe, a deafening holographic chime rings directly in Ha-Jun's skull: *DINGGGGGG!!*.
panels.prose_hi: Isse pehle ki wah saans le sake, ek gaganbhedi holographic jhankar sidhe ha-jun ki khopdi mein bajti hai: *DINGGGGGG!!*.

panels.action: A neon-violet system window materializes: [MANDATORY BLOODLINE QUEST: ENTER THE SUBTERRANEAN VOID] | [TIME LIMIT: 03:00:00].
panels.prose_en: A neon-violet system window materializes: [MANDATORY BLOODLINE QUEST: ENTER THE SUBTERRANEAN VOID] | [TIME LIMIT: 03:00:00].
panels.prose_hi: Ek nion-violet system window sakar hoti hai: [anivarya raktarekha khoj: bhumigat shunya mein pravesh karen] | [samay sima: 03:00:00].

panels.action: The screen pulses crimson: [PENALTY UPON FAILURE: PERMANENT MANA COLLAPSE & GLOBAL EXPOSURE OF SOVEREIGN LINEAGE].
panels.prose_en: The screen pulses crimson: [PENALTY UPON FAILURE: PERMANENT MANA COLLAPSE & GLOBAL EXPOSURE OF SOVEREIGN LINEAGE].
panels.prose_hi: Scrin lal rang ki spandan karti hai: [vifalta par dand: sthayi man patan aur samprabhu vansh ka vaishvik pradarshan].

panels.shot: looking out window at dark auditorium cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun stares out the third-floor window toward the dilapidated Victorian auditorium where faint purple miasma leaks from basement vents: 'Is university ke neeche kuch chupa hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Is university ke neeche... koi purana raaz chupa hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stares out the third-floor window toward the dilapidated Victorian auditorium where faint purple miasma leaks from basement vents: 'Is university ke neeche kuch chupa hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun teesri manjil ki khidki se bahar jeern-shirn victorian sabhagaar ki or dekhta hai, jahan basement ke jharokhon se halka baingani rang ka myasma resata hai: 'kya vishwavidyalaya ke neeche kuch chhupa hai.'
